high_level_description: The image is a news article headline from Livemint, dated February 11, 2024, at 4:00 PM IST. The headline reads: "Israel’s chipmaker Tower Semiconductor proposes to set up $8 billion plant in India: report." Below the headline, there is a subheading that states, "Tower Semiconductor is looking to manufacture 65 nanometre and 40 nanometre chips in India, says the report."
